overview_description.description: Verse helps large energy buyers Connect, Contain, and Control their global power portfolios: connect to the grid faster leveraging flexibility; contain energy cost and risk with real-time analytics and strategic procurement; and control assets to maximize portfolio value through real-time optimization. Verse team blends deep energy-market expertise with modern software engineering and product design to deliver usable, scalable tools to manage power costs and risks.

product.name: Aria Platform
product.description: An AI-enabled enterprise energy management platform offering applications for planning, procuring, and operating clean energy portfolios.

product.name: Planning Application
product.description: Tool to set clean energy goals and create customized procurement roadmaps based on energy load and decarbonization targets.

product.name: Valuation & Transact Application
product.description: Application to evaluate clean energy offers and facilitate procurement of assets aligned with organizational goals.

product.name: Data Hub
product.description: Centralized repository of harmonized electricity, natural gas, and renewable energy market data for informed decision-making.

product.name: Portfolio Insights
product.description: Analytics tool to validate, report on, and forecast clean energy portfolio performance and costs.

product.name: Risk Management Application
product.description: Tool to assess electricity price risk and develop tailored hedging strategies based on portfolio and company risk parameters.
